basics.name: Alex Morgan
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack & Frontend Architect
basics.summary: Full-Stack Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience specializing in high-performance web applications, distributed frontend architectures, and reactive systems. Proven track record of scaling user-facing applications to 2M+ active users, optimizing Core Web Vitals by 42%, and mentoring high-velocity engineering teams across modern TypeScript ecosystems.

work.name: Vanguard Cloud Platforms
work.summary: Architected next-generation enterprise cloud monitoring dashboards and real-time visualization tooling.
highlights: Architected an event-driven telemetry dashboard using Angular, Signals, and WebSockets, supporting 60 FPS real-time rendering across 50,000 streaming data points.
Spearheaded micro-frontend migration strategy reducing client bundle transfer sizes by 38% and lowering average time-to-interactive (TTI) to under 800ms.
Established automated end-to-end regression pipelines in Playwright and GitHub Actions, raising release confidence and eliminating production deployment rollbacks.
Mentored 8 senior and mid-level engineers through bi-weekly architecture RFC reviews and code craftsmanship workshops.

work.name: Nexus Financial Technologies
work.summary: Engineered compliance and transaction processing workflows for institutional trading clients.
highlights: Led full rewrite of merchant onboarding form flow into a modular state machine, increasing completion conversion rate by 24%.
Implemented high-density financial data tables with canvas-virtualized rendering, eliminating UI lockup during peak volatility periods.
Collaborated with security teams to ensure SOC2 Type II and GDPR compliance across all client authentication workflows.

work.name: Starlight Interactive
work.summary: Built collaborative web tools, interactive canvas editors, and responsive client portals.
highlights: Developed custom canvas-based annotation and simulation editors using Fabric.js and TypeScript for digital learning suites.
Integrated REST and GraphQL API gateways with offline-first client caching via IndexedDB and Service Workers.

projects.name: HyperCanvas Studio
projects.description: Collaborative, GPU-accelerated infinite canvas engine built in WebAssembly and TypeScript.
highlights: Engineered spatial indexing algorithm indexing 100K+ vector nodes at smooth 60fps frame rates.
Reached 4.2k stars on GitHub and featured on Hacker News front page.

projects.name: DataPulse CLI
projects.description: High-throughput log analyzer and stream parsing tool with terminal dashboard rendering.
highlights: Processed 200MB/sec compressed telemetry logs with sub-15ms parsing latency.

awards.title: Outstanding Engineering Excellence Award
awards.summary: Recognized for architecting and delivering the mission-critical telemetry system 3 weeks ahead of schedule.

awards.title: 1st Place – Global Open Tech Hackathon
awards.summary: Built an accessible offline-first medical intake portal using WebAssembly and local PWA caches.

volunteer.summary: Taught web fundamentals and guided career transition projects for underrepresented students entering technology.
highlights: Mentored over 45 students through hands-on full-stack development bootcamps with an 82% job placement rate.

references.name: Jordan Chen
references.reference: Alex is an exceptional engineer whose architecture rigor and leadership elevated our entire frontend division. Any team would be lucky to have them.
